title: Gunpowdered Zombies!
description: Zombies have a chance to drop gunpowder, perfect for modded zombie survival.
body:
Gunpowder Zombies tweaks zombie loot to better fit combat-heavy and modded survival worlds. It is built to stay lightweight while making explosive and gun-based gameplay easier to maintain.

Features
• Zombies have a chance to drop gunpowder when killed
• Drop amount and chance can be adjusted
• No commands or setup required
• Works in existing worlds

Compatibility
• Designed with TACZ zombie packs in mind
• Safe to use alongside most mods
• Does not replace vanilla loot tables

Use Cases
• Gun-focused survival worlds
• Apocalypse or outbreak-style modpacks
• Players who want renewable gunpowder without farms
